name: Traffic Stop Duties
explanation: In Virginia, drivers are legally required to stop safely, provide identification, and comply with lawful orders, but you retain constitutional protections against unlawful searches.

name: Invoking Silence
explanation: The Fifth Amendment protects your right to refuse to answer self-incriminating questions during custody, but you must invoke it clearly and explicitly.

name: Exiting the Vehicle
explanation: Under Pennsylvania v. Mimms, an officer has absolute authority to order a driver out of a vehicle during a lawful stop for roadside safety reasons.
